note: Calibration provenance for every whole_piece reference constant in the verifier's measurers. Each reference is a corpus-median anchor measured on ONE (transcriber x corpus) pair. Swapping either silently invalidates it -- the signed d stays computable, the verdicts stay confident, and the faithfulness rate collapses with no error anywhere. #101 FRONT 9 Finding 2 measured that collapse at 0.979 -> 0.236 for dynamics on a single stale line; FRONT 10 replicated it for articulation at 0.950 -> 0.438. RES-001 checks this file against the measurer source, so recalibrating means editing BOTH and the check fails until they agree.
